questions.question: What is the magnitude of the vector u = 2i - 3j + 6k?
What is the unit vector in the direction of v = 3i - 4j?
The direction cosines (l, m, n) of any non-zero vector satisfy:
questions.explanation: l = cos α, m = cos β, n = cos γ. Since the unit vector has magnitude 1, l² + m² + n² = cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1.

questions.question: What is the dot product of two vectors a = 2i + j - 3k and b = 3i - 2j + 4k?
Two non-zero vectors a and b are perpendicular (orthogonal) if and only if:
questions.explanation: a · b = |a||b| cos(θ). Since |a| ≠ 0 and |b| ≠ 0, a · b = 0 ⇔ cos(θ) = 0 ⇔ θ = 90° (perpendicular).

questions.question: Two non-zero vectors a and b are parallel (collinear) if and only if:
questions.explanation: |a × b| = |a||b| sin(θ). For parallel vectors, θ = 0° or 180°, so sin(θ) = 0 ⇔ a × b = 0.

questions.question: What is the projection of vector a onto vector b?
questions.explanation: The scalar projection of a along b is |a| cos θ = (a · b) / |b|.

questions.question: What is the value of i · (j × k)?
questions.explanation: j × k = i. Therefore, i · (j × k) = i · i = 1.

questions.question: What is the value of i × j?
questions.explanation: By the right-hand cyclic rule of unit vectors in ℝ³: i × j = k, j × k = i, k × i = j.

questions.question: What is the value of j × i?
questions.explanation: The vector cross product is anti-commutative: j × i = -(i × j) = -k.

questions.question: What is the value of i · j?
questions.explanation: The unit vectors along orthogonal coordinate axes are perpendicular: θ = 90° ⇒ i · j = |i||j| cos(90°) = 1 · 1 · 0 = 0.

questions.question: The area of a parallelogram with adjacent sides given by vectors a and b is:
questions.explanation: The geometric magnitude of the vector cross product |a × b| = |a||b| sin θ equals the area of the parallelogram formed by a and b.

questions.question: The area of a triangle with adjacent sides represented by vectors a and b is:
questions.explanation: A triangle formed by adjacent sides a and b is half of the parallelogram: Area = (1/2) |a × b|.

questions.question: The scalar triple product a · (b × c) represents:

options.A: The volume of the parallelepiped with coterminous edges a, b, c
options.B: The surface area of a tetrahedron

questions.explanation: The scalar triple product [a b c] = a · (b × c) gives the signed volume of the parallelepiped having vectors a, b, c as coterminous edges.

questions.question: Three vectors a, b, and c are coplanar if and only if:
questions.explanation: If three vectors lie in the same plane, the height of the parallelepiped formed by them is zero, so their volume [a b c] = a · (b × c) = 0.

questions.question: The volume of a tetrahedron with coterminous edges a, b, c is:
questions.explanation: The volume of a tetrahedron is one-sixth of the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped: V = (1/6) |a · (b × c)|.

questions.question: What is the work done W by a constant force F producing a displacement d?
questions.explanation: Work is a scalar quantity defined as the dot product of the force vector and the displacement vector: W = F · d = |F||d| cos θ.

questions.question: What is the torque (moment of a force) τ of a force F acting at position r?
questions.explanation: Torque is a pseudo-vector defined by the cross product τ = r × F.

questions.question: For any vector a, the value of a × a is:
questions.explanation: The angle between a vector and itself is θ = 0°. Since sin(0°) = 0, a × a = 0.

questions.question: For any vector a, the value of a · a is:
questions.explanation: a · a = |a||a| cos(0°) = |a|² (the square of its magnitude).

questions.question: If a = i + 2j - k and b = 3i - 2j + 2k, what is a + b?
What is the cross product i × k?
questions.explanation: Since k × i = j, reversing the order gives i × k = -j.

questions.question: What is the cosine of the angle between a = i + j and b = j + k?
If vector a is perpendicular to vector b, then |a × b| is equal to:
The vector triple product a × (b × c) can be expanded using the BAC-CAB rule as:
questions.explanation: By the vector triple product identity: a × (b × c) = (a · c)b - (a · b)c = b(a · c) - c(a · b).

questions.question: If [a b c] = 5, what is the value of [b c a]?
questions.explanation: Cyclic permutations of vectors preserve the scalar triple product: [a b c] = [b c a] = [c a b] = 5.

questions.question: If [a b c] = 5, what is the value of [b a c]?
questions.explanation: An anti-cyclic (non-cyclic) swap of any two adjacent vectors reverses the sign of the determinant: [b a c] = -[a b c] = -5.

questions.question: What is the angle between the vector a = i + j + k and the x-axis?
questions.explanation: |a| = √(1² + 1² + 1²) = √3. The x-component is 1, so direction cosine cos(α) = 1/√3 ⇒ α = cos⁻¹(1/√3).

questions.question: If a force F = 3i + 2j - k moves a particle from (1, 1, 1) to (2, 3, 0), the work done is:
If |a + b| = |a - b|, then the vectors a and b are:
questions.explanation: Squaring: |a + b|² = |a - b|² ⇒ |a|² + 2(a · b) + |b|² = |a|² - 2(a · b) + |b|² ⇒ 4(a · b) = 0 ⇒ a · b = 0. Hence a ⊥ b.

questions.question: A vector of magnitude 0 with an arbitrary direction is called a:
questions.explanation: A null vector (0) has zero magnitude and its direction is indeterminate.

questions.question: What is the position vector of the point P(-2, 5, 3)?
questions.explanation: The position vector OP from the origin (0, 0, 0) to P(x, y, z) is xi + yj + zk = -2i + 5j + 3k.

questions.question: If a × b = 0 and a · b = 0 for non-zero vector a, then:

options.A: b must be the zero vector

questions.explanation: a × b = 0 requires a ∥ b (θ = 0° or 180°), whereas a · b = 0 requires a ⊥ b (θ = 90°). Since a non-zero vector cannot simultaneously be parallel and perpendicular to a non-zero vector, b must be 0.

questions.question: The value of [i k j] is:
questions.explanation: [i k j] = i · (k × j). Since j × k = i, k × j = -i. Thus i · (-i) = -1.
